vsm2.12:49.1: Tattha catasso bhūmiyoti cattāri jhānāni veditabbāni. Vuttañhetaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ‘‘iddhiyā katamā catasso bhūmiyo? Vivekajabhūmi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ, pītisukhabhūmi dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ, upekkhāsukhabhūmi tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ, adukkhamasukhabhūmi catutthaṃ jhānaṃ. Iddhiyā imā catasso bhūmiyo iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya iddhivikubbanatāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivasitāya iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.9).
vsm2.12:49.2: Ettha ca purimāni tīṇi jhānāni yasmā pītipharaṇena ca sukhapharaṇena ca sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā lahumudukammaññakāyo iddhiṃ pāpuṇāti, tasmā iminā pariyāyena iddhilābhāya saṃvattanato sambhārabhūmiyoti veditabbāni.
vsm2.12:50.1: Cattāro pādāti cattāro iddhipādā veditabbā. Vuttañhetaṃ ‘‘iddhiyā katame cattāro pādā? Idha bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Vīriya… citta… vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Iddhiyā ime cattāro pādā iddhilābhāya…pe… iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.9).
vsm2.12:51.1: Ettha ca chandahetuko chandādhiko vā samādhi chandasamādhi. Kattukamyatāchandaṃ adhipatiṃ karitvā paṭiladdhasamādhissetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
vsm2.12:51.2: Padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā padhānasaṅkhārā. Catukiccasādhakassa sammappadhānavīriyassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
vsm2.12:51.3: Samannāgatanti chandasamādhinā ca padhānasaṅkhārehi ca upetaṃ.
vsm2.12:52.1: Iddhipādanti nipphattipariyāyena vā ijjhanaṭṭhena, ijjhanti etāya sattā iddhā vuddhā ukkaṃsagatā hontīti iminā vā pariyāyena iddhīti saṅkhaṃ gatānaṃ abhiññācittasampayuttānaṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārānaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena pādabhūtaṃ sesacittacetasikarāsinti attho.
vsm2.12:53.1: Atha vā pajjate anenāti pādo. Pāpuṇīyatīti attho.
vsm2.12:53.2: Iddhiyā pādo iddhipādo. Chandādīnametaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Yathāha – ‘‘chandañce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ, ayaṃ vuccati chandasamādhi. So anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ…pe… padahati, ime vuccanti padhānasaṅkhārā. Iti ayañca chando ayañca chandasamādhi ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.825).
vsm2.12:54.1: Aṭṭha padānīti chandādīni aṭṭha veditabbāni. Vuttañhetaṃ ‘‘iddhiyā katamāni aṭṭha padāni? Chandañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ. Chando na samādhi, samādhi na chando. Añño chando, añño samādhi. Vīriyañce bhikkhu… cittañce bhikkhu… vīmaṃsañce bhikkhu nissāya labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassekaggataṃ. Vīmaṃsā na samādhi, samādhi na vīmaṃsā. Aññā vīmaṃsā, añño samādhi. Iddhiyā imāni aṭṭha padāni iddhilābhāya…pe… iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.9).
vsm2.12:54.2: Ettha hi iddhimuppādetukāmatāchando samādhinā ekato niyuttova iddhilābhāya saṃvattati;
vsm2.12:54.4: Tasmā imāni aṭṭha padāni vuttānīti veditabbāni.
vsm2.12:55.1: Soḷasa mūlānīti soḷasahi ākārehi āneñjatā cittassa veditabbā. Vuttañhetaṃ – ‘‘iddhiyā kati mūlāni? Soḷasa mūlāni –
vsm2.12:55.2: anonataṃ cittaṃ kosajje na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.3: anunnataṃ cittaṃ uddhacce na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.4: anabhinataṃ cittaṃ rāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.5: anapanataṃ cittaṃ byāpāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.6: anissitaṃ cittaṃ diṭṭhiyā na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.7: appaṭibaddhaṃ cittaṃ chandarāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.8: vippamuttaṃ cittaṃ kāmarāge na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.9: visaṃyuttaṃ cittaṃ kilese na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.10: vimariyādikataṃ cittaṃ kilesamariyāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.11: ekattagataṃ cittaṃ nānattakilese na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.12: saddhāya pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ assaddhiye na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.13: vīriyena pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ kosajje na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.14: satiyā pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ pamāde na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.15: samādhinā pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ uddhacce na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.16: paññāya pariggahitaṃ cittaṃ avijjāya na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ,
vsm2.12:55.17: obhāsagataṃ cittaṃ avijjandhakāre na iñjatīti āneñjaṃ.
vsm2.12:55.18: Iddhiyā imāni soḷasa mūlāni iddhilābhāya…pe… iddhivesārajjāya saṃvattantī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.9).
vsm2.12:56.1: Kāmañca esa attho evaṃ samāhite cittetiādināpi siddhoyeva, paṭhamajjhānādīnaṃ pana iddhiyā bhūmipādapadamūlabhāvadassanatthaṃ puna vutto.
vsm2.12:56.2: Purimo ca suttesu āgatanayo. Ayaṃ paṭisambhidāyaṃ.
vsm2.12:57.1: Ñāṇena adhiṭṭhahantoti svāyamete iddhiyā bhūmipādapadabhūte dhamme sampādetvā abhiññāpādakaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya
vsm2.12:57.2: sace sataṃ icchati ‘‘sataṃ homi sataṃ homī’’ti parikammaṃ katvā puna abhiññāpādakaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya adhiṭṭhāti,
vsm2.12:57.5: Sace evaṃ na ijjhati puna parikammaṃ katvā dutiyampi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:57.6: Saṃyuttaṭṭhakathāyaṃ hi ekavāraṃ dvevāraṃ samāpajjituṃ vaṭṭatīti vuttaṃ.
vsm2.12:58.1: Tattha pādakajjhānacittaṃ nimittārammaṇaṃ. Parikammacittāni satārammaṇāni vā sahassārammaṇāni vā,
vsm2.12:58.2: tāni ca kho vaṇṇavasena, no paṇṇattivasena.
vsm2.12:58.3: Adhiṭṭhānacittampi tatheva satārammaṇaṃ vā sahassārammaṇaṃ vā.
vsm2.12:58.4: Taṃ pubbe vuttaṃ appanācittamiva gotrabhuanantaraṃ ekameva uppajjati rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānikaṃ.
vsm2.12:59.1: Yampi paṭisambhidāyaṃ vuttaṃ ‘‘pakatiyā eko bahukaṃ āvajjati sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā satasahassaṃ vā, āvajjitvā ñāṇena adhiṭṭhāti ‘bahuko homī’ti, bahuko hoti, yathā āyasmā cūḷapanthako’’ti (paṭi. ma. 3.10).
vsm2.12:59.6: samāpattito vuṭṭhahitvā puna bahuko homīti āvajjitvā tato paraṃ pavattānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ catunnaṃ vā pubbabhāgacittānaṃ anantarā uppannena sanniṭṭhāpanavasena adhiṭṭhānanti laddhanāmena ekeneva abhiññāñāṇena adhiṭṭhātīti
vsm2.12:60.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘yathā āyasmā cūḷapanthako’’ti, taṃ bahudhābhāvassa kāyasakkhidassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ. Taṃ pana vatthunā dīpetabbaṃ. Te kira dvebhātaro panthe jātattā panthakāti nāmaṃ labhiṃsu. Tesaṃ jeṭṭho mahāpanthako, so pabbajitvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. Arahā hutvā cūḷapanthakaṃ pabbājetvā –
vsm2.12:60.3: So taṃ catūhi māsehi paguṇaṃ kātuṃ nāsakkhi. Atha naṃ thero abhabbo tvaṃ sāsaneti vihārato nīhari.
vsm2.12:61.2: Jīvako theraṃ upasaṅkamitvā ‘‘sve, bhante, bhagavatā saddhiṃ pañcabhikkhusatāni gahetvā amhākaṃ gehe bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā’’ti āha.
vsm2.12:61.3: Theropi ṭhapetvā cūḷapanthakaṃ sesānaṃ adhivāsemīti adhivāsesi.
vsm2.12:61.5: Bhagavā dibbacakkhunā disvā taṃ upasaṅkamitvā kasmā rodasīti āha.
vsm2.12:62.1: Bhagavā na sajjhāyaṃ kātuṃ asakkonto mama sāsane abhabbo nāma hoti, mā soci bhikkhūti
vsm2.12:62.3: iddhiyā pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ abhinimminitvā adāsi, handa bhikkhu imaṃ parimajjanto rajoharaṇaṃ rajoharaṇanti punappunaṃ sajjhāyaṃ karohīti.
vsm2.12:62.4: Tassa tathā karoto taṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ ahosi.
vsm2.12:62.5: So parisuddhaṃ vatthaṃ, natthettha doso, attabhāvassa panāyaṃ dosoti saññaṃ paṭilabhitvā
vsm2.12:62.6: pañcasu khandhesu ñāṇaṃ otāretvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā anulomato gotrabhusamīpaṃ pāpesi.
vsm2.12:63.2: Tassa gāthāpariyosāne catupaṭisambhidāchaḷabhiññāparivārā nava lokuttaradhammā hatthagatāva ahesuṃ.
vsm2.12:64.1: Satthā dutiyadivase jīvakassa gehaṃ agamāsi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
vsm2.12:64.2: Atha dakkhiṇodakāvasāne yāguyā diyyamānāya hatthena pattaṃ pidahi.
vsm2.12:64.3: Jīvako kiṃ bhanteti pucchi. Vihāre eko bhikkhu atthīti.
vsm2.12:64.4: So purisaṃ pesesi ‘‘gaccha, ayyaṃ gahetvā sīghaṃ ehī’’ti.
vsm2.12:66.1: Atha so puriso gantvā kāsāvehi ekapajjotaṃ ārāmaṃ disvā āgantvā bhikkhūhi bharito bhante ārāmo, nāhaṃ jānāmi katamo so ayyoti āha.
vsm2.12:66.2: Tato naṃ bhagavā āha ‘‘gaccha yaṃ paṭhamaṃ passasi, taṃ cīvarakaṇṇe gahetvā ‘satthā taṃ āmantetī’ti vatvā ānehī’’ti.
vsm2.12:66.3: So taṃ gantvā therasseva cīvarakaṇṇe aggahesi.
vsm2.12:66.5: Thero ‘‘gaccha tva’’nti taṃ uyyojetvā mukhadhovanādisarīrakiccaṃ niṭṭhapetvā paṭhamataraṃ gantvā pattāsane nisīdi.
vsm2.12:67.1: Tatra ye te bahū nimmitā te aniyametvā nimmitattā iddhimatā sadisāva honti.
vsm2.12:67.2: Ṭhānanisajjādīsu vā bhāsitatuṇhībhāvādīsu vā yaṃ yaṃ iddhimā karoti, taṃ tadeva karonti.
vsm2.12:67.3: Sace pana nānāvaṇṇe kātukāmo hoti, keci paṭhamavaye, keci majjhimavaye, keci pacchimavaye, tathā dīghakese, upaḍḍhamuṇḍe, muṇḍe, missakese, upaḍḍharattacīvare, paṇḍukacīvare, padabhāṇadhammakathāsarabhaññapañhapucchanapañhavissajjanarajanapacanacīvarasibbanadhovanādīni karonte aparepi vā nānappakārake kātukāmo hoti, tena pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya ettakā bhikkhū paṭhamavayā hontūtiādinā nayena parikammaṃ katvā puna samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:67.4: Adhiṭṭhānacittena saddhiṃ icchiticchitappakārāyeva hontīti. Esa nayo bahudhāpi hutvā eko hotītiādīsu.
vsm2.12:68.1: Ayaṃ pana viseso, iminā bhikkhunā evaṃ bahubhāvaṃ nimminitvā puna ‘‘ekova hutvā caṅkamissāmi, sajjhāyaṃ karissāmi, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī’’ti cintetvā vā, ‘‘ayaṃ vihāro appabhikkhuko, sace keci āgamissanti ‘kuto ime ettakā ekasadisā bhikkhū, addhā therassa esa ānubhāvo’ti maṃ jānissantī’’ti appicchatāya vā
vsm2.12:68.2: antarāva ‘‘eko homī’’ti icchantena pādakajjhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya
vsm2.12:68.3: ‘‘eko homī’’ti parikammaṃ katvā puna samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya ‘‘eko homī’’ti adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm2.12:68.5: Evaṃ akaronto pana yathā paricchinnakālavasena sayameva eko hoti.
